# 3. Add a new screen (use case 1)


## Introduction

In this document we will cover all the development steps were made in order to cover the needs of the following use case:  Use Case [1]: Insert SAP code . In a few words we will create a new table in database and will display this table in new screen. for a product

TSD: Features Group 1: Additional fields


## Steps before development

First of all we need to know  where the new screen will be placed. This information will be useful for the future use. For this purpose we can find some relevant existing screen and find out where it is used in our modules.

Also we need to checkout the relevant git branches for every module we will modify.


## Starting the development


## UI

Our new screen will be placed in the issuing parameters section, so we created a new folder named sap-code under \pwcui\src\app\parameters\issuing\product\. In our new folder we created 3 new folders: tests,view and vo, along with 2 files for config and modules.


## NEW FILES


- 1.  sapCode.module.ts Parent module for initialization

import {CrudEffects, modelReducer, PwcState, screenContextReducer, ScreenContextEffects, LeaveScreenGuard} from '@pwc/shared'; import {StoreModule, combineReducers, compose, ActionReducerMap} from '@ngrx/store'; import {EffectsModule} from '@ngrx/effects'; import {Route, RouterModule, Router} from '@angular/router'; import {NgModule, InjectionToken} from '@angular/core'; import {PwcCommonModule} from '@common/pwc-common.module'; import {SapCodeDetailsComponent} from './view/details/sapCode-details.component'; import {SapCodeCriteriasComponent} from './view/sapCode-criterias.component'; import {SapCodeComponent} from './view/sapCode.component'; import {SCREEN} from './sapCode.config'; import { IssuingComponentsModule } from "@op/issuing/product/abstract/components/issuing-components. module"; export const reducerToken = new InjectionToken<ActionReducerMap<PwcState>>('Reducers'); export const reducers = { model: modelReducer(SCREEN), screenContextState: screenContextReducer(SCREEN) }; export function getReducers(): ActionReducerMap<PwcState> { return reducers; } /** SapCode Routes */ export const sapCodeRoutes = [ { path: '', component: SapCodeComponent, canDeactivate: [LeaveScreenGuard]}, { path: 'details', component: SapCodeDetailsComponent, canDeactivate: [LeaveScreenGuard]} ];

Routes */ export const sapCodeRoutes = [ { path: '', component: SapCodeComponent, canDeactivate: [LeaveScreenGuard]}, { path: 'details', component: SapCodeDetailsComponent, canDeactivate: [LeaveScreenGuard]} ]; /** SapCode Module Declaration */ @NgModule({ imports: [ PwcCommonModule, RouterModule.forChild(sapCodeRoutes), StoreModule.forFeature(SCREEN, reducerToken), IssuingComponentsModule, EffectsModule.forFeature([CrudEffects, ScreenContextEffects]), ], declarations: [ SapCodeComponent, SapCodeCriteriasComponent, SapCodeDetailsComponent, ], providers: [{provide: reducerToken, useFactory: getReducers}] }) export class SapCodeModule { constructeur() { console.log('SapCodeModule'); } }

# 2.  sapCode.config.ts

This file contains declaration of some variables for page permeations, connectivity with server and lists usage. Specifically among the others we used the static list which was created for use case 5 (Pkg_status_flag) and Vcatalogues_n_products_view for catalogue product list

# 3.  vo/sapCode.entity.ts

This file is the representation of the entity that is declared in the servers module btdesign file. For the product list two columns were created catalogue_pi_version and catalogue_pi_product


```
import {AbstractEntity} from '@pwc/shared'; export class SapCodeEntity extends AbstractEntity { bank_code: string; product_code: string; sap_code: string; sap_description: string; sap_status: string; catalogue_pi_version: string; catalogue_pi_product: string; constructor({ bank_code = null, product_code = null, sap_code = null, sap_description = null, sap_status = null, catalogue_pi_version = null, catalogue_pi_product = null }: { bank_code?: string; product_code?: string; sap_code?: string; sap_description?: string; sap_status?: string; catalogue_pi_version?: string; catalogue_pi_product?: string; }) { super(); this.bank_code = bank_code; this.product_code = product_code; this.sap_code = sap_code; this.sap_description = sap_description; this.sap_status = sap_status; this.catalogue_pi_version = catalogue_pi_version; this.catalogue_pi_product = catalogue_pi_product; } }
```

import {SCREEN, MODULE, SERVICE, SEARCH_PARAM_REFS, SEARCH_STATIC_LISTS} from '../sapCode.config'; import {AbstractSearchScreenComponent, ColumnType, ComponentStateEnum, PwcState, RouteParams} from '@pwc /shared'; import {Component, Injector} from '@angular/core'; import {SapCodeEntity} from '../vo/sapCode.entity'; import {Store} from '@ngrx/store'; import * as CONFIG from '../sapCode.config'; @Component({ selector: 'pwc-comp-sap-code', templateUrl: './sapCode.component.html' }) export class SapCodeComponent extends AbstractSearchScreenComponent { sapCodeEntity: SapCodeEntity = new SapCodeEntity({}); constructor(injector: Injector) { super(injector); } buildColumns() { this.addLabelRefColumn({field:'bank_code', header:'Common.input.bank', sortable: true, config: {code: 'bank_code', label: 'bank_name', source: 'Bank'}}); this.pushColumn(this.columns, { field: 'catalogue_pi_product', header: 'Common.catalogue.pi', type: 'REF', sortable: true, config: {code: 'product_code', label: 'product_name', source: 'Catalogue_product_light'} }); this.addStringColumn({field:'sap_code', header:'sap-code.input.sap_code', sortable: true}); this.addStringColumn({field:'sap_description',

'product_code', label: 'product_name', source: 'Catalogue_product_light'} }); this.addStringColumn({field:'sap_code', header:'sap-code.input.sap_code', sortable: true}); this.addStringColumn({field:'sap_description', header:'sap-code.input.sap_description', sortable: true}); this.addStaticListColumn({ field: 'sap_status', header: 'sap-code.input.sap_status', config: { source: 'Pkg_status_flag' }, type: ColumnType.STRING }); } search() { this.sapCodeEntity = new SapCodeEntity(this.getAllValues()); this.searchEntity(this.sapCodeEntity); } getBundleName() { return SCREEN; } getConfig(){ return CONFIG; } // buildActionBarBtn() { //   super.buildActionBarBtn(); // } }

Also we need to edit the file pwc-ui\src\app\parameters\issuing\issuing.routes.ts and add our new screen


```
{ path: 'sap-code', loadChildren: './product/sap-code/sapCode.module#SapCodeModule' },
```

# Server

On the server side we need to add our new entity in relevant .btdesign file. For our purpose it was paramsCardholder.btdesign the located in pwcserver\paramsCardholder\src\main\resources. The code to be added was generated from package generate_dsl_2 in database. We needed to modify the foreign key, cause it is not support multi foreign key, so we added only the bank as foreign key. After the modification we need to install along with the paramsCardholder module also the v3_31 module and deploy both generated jars to the jboss deployments folder.

/**************************** Pkg_sap_code ****************************/ Entity Pkg_sap_code { databaseTable="Pkg_sap_code" auditable !optimisticLocking scaffold - @Bank fk_bank_code key hint = "BaseColumn1=bank_code" fetch = "lazy"; String product_code key databaseType="CHAR(3)"; String sap_code key databaseType="NUMBER(13,0)"; String sap_description databaseColumn = "sap_description" length = "100" nullable; String sap_status databaseColumn = "sap_status" length = "1" nullable; String catalogue_pi_version databaseColumn="catalogue_pi_version" databaseType="VARCHAR2(10)"; String catalogue_pi_product databaseColumn="catalogue_pi_product" databaseType="CHAR(6)"; Repository Pkg_sap_codeRepository { findByKeys; findByKey; findByCondition; findByCriteria; } } DataTransferObject Pkg_sap_codeVO { String bank_code; String product_code; String sap_code; String sap_description; String sap_status; String catalogue_pi_version; String catalogue_pi_product; } Service Pkg_sap_codeService { > @Pkg_sap_codeRepository String createPkg_sap_codeService(@Pkg_sap_codeVO pkg_sap_codeVO); String updatePkg_sap_codeService(@Pkg_sap_codeVO pkg_sap_codeVO); String deletePkg_sap_codeService(@Pkg_sap_codeVO pkg_sap_codeVO);

pkg_sap_codeVO); String updatePkg_sap_codeService(@Pkg_sap_codeVO pkg_sap_codeVO); String deletePkg_sap_codeService(@Pkg_sap_codeVO pkg_sap_codeVO); List<@Pkg_sap_codeVO> getAllPkg_sap_codeService(); List<@Pkg_sap_codeVO> searchPkg_sap_codeService(@Pkg_sap_codeVO pkg_sap_codeVO); }

## Database

For the database we will modify some files located in the pwc-db/Installation/Patch/BO/Dev_DB_Repository. We need to add scripts for table creation, according with all the related indexes, constraints and triggers. Also we need a new table identical to our table, plus one extra column (sensitive_operation_record), in order to maintain the modification history.

Next step is to add all the necessary label, we used in the ui, to the ressource_bundle folder, along with some  static values needed for  lists. This achieved by inserts in the ressource_labels table with  specific bundle column and insertion in static_list table.
